weight_decay_selection.rule: Minimum selected-checkpoint source-selection RX-equal CE over 12 RX and three fixed streams; exact tie smaller wd
weight_decay_selection.auxiliary_rule: Carry the primary selected-endpoint wd choices to epoch10/final40; never select an endpoint after seeing results

C1.interpretation: Development promotion means worth separately confirming; failure is not proof of universal ineffectiveness. No extra seed or method search is authorized.

C2.interpretation: Development promotion means worth separately confirming; failure is not proof of universal ineffectiveness. No extra seed or method search is authorized.

uncertainty.unit: 12 observed source-selection RX; three fixed stream values are averaged within RX before cluster resampling

interpretation: Source-CV development/selection findings on 12 observed source-selection RX and three fixed paired streams; not independent confirmation, an unseen-RX population estimate, seed-population uncertainty, or a pure objective causal effect.
